name: Greek Salad with Edamame, Cucumber, Bell Pepper, Tomato & Olives
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
Place oil, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to coat.
Large dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
Trim and large dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
Halve olives lengthwise. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between bowls and enjoy!
author: Mealime
